caption:
The best line you can add to your ad is who it's NOT for.

Most ads try to appeal to everyone, so they attract everyone: bargain hunters, tire kickers, people outside your area.

One honest line filters them before you pay for them:
→ "Not for people looking for the cheapest quote."
→ "Only for homeowners in Orlando and Kissimmee."
→ "If you need it done today, we're not your company."

You'll get fewer clicks. You'll also get fewer bad calls, fewer no-shows and a lower cost per actual sale.

And the algorithm learns from who responds. Better people respond, better people get shown your ad next.

What's your "not for" line? Drop it in the comments.
